mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings potential, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (UNRATE > 5.0%), or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both housing starts and non-farm payrolls signal a broad-based economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and PAYEMS decline, or the interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the market prices in expected policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 2000 thousand units signals weak residential construction and reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (HOUST < 2000), or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls below 134,000 thousand persons signals labor market weakness and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (PAYEMS < 134000), or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.5% during a monetary policy cycle signals reduced liquidity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.
